Latency SLO: target <= 300ms 95th for streaming single-turn responses; end-to-end (user-visible) <= 500ms
Throughput: steady-state 150-300 concurrent agents during peak, bursts to 600
Model preferences: open-chat variants with streaming + tool-calling support (prefer quantized LLMs but want Redwood-managed kernel selection)

Observability: token-level cost + per-route latency breakdowns, trace hooks for tool-call failures

notes:
Lead from Head of Product (Samir Rao). Typical CRM-style notes below — shorthand and action items.

- Integration work: engineering will provide sandbox SFDC credentials and sample cadence CSV (done). They asked about webhook retry semantics and idempotency for tool-calls.
- Rollout plan (they): staged pilot w/ 10 SDRs -> 50 -> organization-wide. Success metric = 20% increase in qualified outbound meetings and <2% automation error rate on CRM writes.
- Pricing discussion: Samir requested a modeled TCO showing cost per booked meeting at different throughput/quantization settings. Send Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + quantization.
- Misc: Mentioned competitors evaluated: OpenAI + Anthropic; main differentiator for them is predictable latency + VPC/dedicated option for PCI/regulated customers.
